_note: Findings the low-confidence callable pass reports but that are NOT dead (see scripts/check_vulture.py). web_parse's handle_starttag/handle_endtag/handle_data are HTMLParser callbacks the stdlib invokes by name. PluginContext.redaction_mode is advertised plugin-contract API: the shipped terminal plugin happens to read defaults.INPUT_REDACTION_MODE instead, but removing a documented contract method would break third-party plugins. The five genuinely-dead callables that were here when this pass was added (protected_count, to_wire, secure_directory, _check_resolved_ips, write_manifest) were deleted rather than baselined. Entries carry no line number: an edit above a baselined finding would otherwise shift it into looking new (proven -- one added line failed the gate). The gate also fails on a STALE entry, so a fixed finding must be removed rather than left to pre-approve a later regression in the same place.
